recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser tower-defense game called **Neo-Tokyo Meme Reactor Defense**. Preserve a five-row, seven-column lane defense loop: cards buy defenders with a resource counter, enemies walk from right to left, defenders shoot/block/produce/explode/melee, solo waves accelerate, local versus allows a second player to spend a separate enemy currency, and failure occurs when an enemy crosses the left edge. Reinterpret all presentation as a satirical neon anime chrome reactor defense: Volts instead of sun, Clones instead of brains, doomscroll clone attackers, a premium Gyatt Core melee defender, cyber grid background, meme broadcast feedback, and one-thumb mobile buttons/cards.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: Browser-native lane tower defense with solo wave defense and optional local two-player versus spawning.
- objective: Spend generated resources to place defenders in a 5x7 grid and prevent enemies from crossing the left reactor/house edge.
- input model: One-thumb/tap card selection, then tap a lane tile to place a defender; in versus, top player taps enemy card then lane. Canvas taps collect falling resource pickups.
- core loop: Start match, earn resources, select unit cards, place defenders, enemies move right-to-left, defenders shoot/produce/block/explode/melee, defeated enemies clear, failure occurs when an enemy crosses the defended edge.
- fail/friction state: Insufficient resources/cooldowns block card selection; occupied grid cells block placement; a crossing enemy triggers the end screen with restart/menu.

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve 5 rows, 7 columns, lane-based placement and right-to-left enemy travel.
- Preserve resource economy starting at 500, +25 collectible drops, producer-generated drops, card costs, cooldowns, hit points, projectile damage, melee executioner/Gyatt Core behavior, bomb radius, boss damage, solo wave acceleration, versus brain/clone economy, pause/restart/menu flow.
- Preserve canvas-scoped touch prevention only during play; menu buttons keep native tap/click behavior.

## Rebuild Premise
Neo-Tokyo Meme Reactor Defense reframes the house/garden as a chrome reactor lane map: cyber towers defend against doomscroll clones in a satirical anime-neon city. The focal identity is the Gyatt Core, a chrome ring melee defender that embodies the premium executioner unit without changing its rules.
